prompt: Which is the cheapest email marketing software with unlimited email sends for tight budgets?
jawaban:
After conducting a web search, there is currently no email marketing software that offers truly unlimited email sends for free or at a very low cost—most platforms impose sending limits, subscriber caps, or charge based on the number of emails or contacts. Even affordable tools typically restrict volume to prevent abuse and manage server loads.

However, here are 10 budget-friendly email marketing platforms that offer low-cost plans with generous sending allowances (but not truly unlimited), suitable for tight budgets:

1. MailerLite - mailerlite.com - Offers a free plan up to 1,000 contacts and 12,000 emails per month, ideal for small businesses on a tight budget.

2. Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) - brevo.com - Provides a free plan with unlimited email sends to 1,000 contacts per day, making it one of the closest to "unlimited" for small lists.

3. Mailchimp - mailchimp.com - Free plan includes up to 500 contacts and 1,000 sends per month, suitable for very small campaigns.

4. Benchmark Email - benchmarkemail.com - Free plan supports up to 2,000 contacts and 14,000 emails per month.

5. Moosend - moosend.com - Offers a free plan with unlimited sends to 500 subscribers, great for small lists.

6. Sendinblue (Brevo) - sendinblue.com - Same as Brevo; free tier allows unlimited daily sends to 1,000 contacts.

7. Elastic Email - elasticemail.com - Pay-as-you-go pricing with low cost per email and a free trial including 100 emails/day.

8. Zoho Campaigns - zohocampaigns.com - Free plan for up to 2,000 contacts and 12,000 emails per month with limited features.

9. Constant Contact - constantcontact.com - No free plan, but offers a 60-day free trial and competitive pricing for small businesses.

10. GetResponse - getresponse.com - Free plan includes up to 1,000 contacts and 300 emails per day.

Note: True "unlimited email sends" without restrictions on list size or sending frequency do not exist in the email marketing industry due to anti-spam policies and infrastructure costs. Brevo (Sendinblue) and Moosend come closest with unlimited sends on their free plans, but are limited by contact count.
